title: ABDA-NL: A Natural-Language Scenario Explorer for Argument-Based Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.00947v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: ABDA-NL adds a natural-language interface to ABDA, a system for argument-based discussion using ASPIC- knowledge bases under grounded semantics. Users see which conclusions are accepted, rejected, or undecided, open an interactive rendering of the grounded discussion game to learn why, explore what-if alternatives by suspending assumptions and rules or changing preferences, ask questions that are answered from a scenario's reference documents, and author new facts, assumptions, and rules in plain English. A large language model provides the bridge between language and formalism: it answers questions from the documents and the current state of the scenario, and it translates plain-English edits into candidate formal statements. The deterministic ABDA engine remains the sole source of arguments, attacks, and acceptance labels, and every proposal of the model is validated and confirmed by the user before it takes effect.

translated_title: ABDA-NL：一个用于基于论证推理的自然语言场景探索器
translated_abstract: ABDA-NL 为 ABDA 系统增加了自然语言界面。ABDA 是一个基于论证的讨论系统，使用基础语义下基于 ASPIC- 知识库进行推理。用户可以查看哪些结论被接受、被拒绝或处于未决状态，打开基础讨论游戏的交互式呈现以了解原因，通过暂停假设和规则或更改偏好来探索“如果……会怎样”的替代方案，提出可从场景参考文档中获得解答的问题，并用平实的英语编写新的事实、假设和规则。大型语言模型充当语言与形式化之间的桥梁：它根据文档和场景的当前状态回答问题，并将平实的英文编辑翻译成候选的形式化语句。确定性的 ABDA 引擎仍然是论证、攻击关系和接受标签的唯一来源，模型提出的每一项建议在生效前都会经过验证并由用户确认。
tldr: ABDA-NL 利用大型语言模型作为自然语言与形式化论证系统之间的桥梁，让用户能够以自然语言探索、质疑和修改基于 ASPIC- 知识库的论证推理场景，同时由确定性的论证引擎保证推理结果的可靠性，并由用户确认所有修改建议。
en_tdlr: ABDA-NL uses a large language model as a bridge between natural language and formal argumentation, enabling users to explore, question, and modify ASPIC--based reasoning scenarios in plain English, while a deterministic ABDA engine ensures the reliability of all argumentation results and users confirm every proposed edit.
